scope: Portable pinned complete native IA32 V8 build/failure entry. Actual Abseil exit and CPU entropy consumers are separately guest-qualified; complete engine and remaining runtime bridges are unqualified.

input_boundary: Requires an unchanged DEPS-populated upstream checkout, installed Linux x64/IA32 sysroots and pinned host Python package. Git revisions/dirty checks cover tracked source; host runtime and Clang resource payloads are individually hashed. Package sysroots remain prepared checkout prerequisites, not files redistributed by GTOS.

zlib_qualification.scope: 真实 zlib 解码与 FileStore 提交后只读缓存刷新工作包；完整 V8/浏览器及成功压缩未验收

ctype_scope: Pinned C/ASCII case conversion, including EOF and unchanged high bytes; no additional locale support
native_standard_stream_scope: Real private static FILE objects: stdout/stderr use GTOS_SYS_WRITE, stdin read explicitly ENOSYS, console seek ESPIPE; regular-file freopen and close lifetime preserved. No general console-input/POSIX descriptor table claim. Console fileno explicitly ENOSYS because no native descriptor service exists; redirected files return their real opaque positive handle.
native_time_format_scope: Pinned unmodified LLVM strftime and time_utils, C locale and non-Linux UTC semantics; formatting of caller tm, not a new RTC/timezone service.
